name: Perl
needs: Perl 5.10 or newer with FFI::Platypus 2.00+ and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
setup: perl -MFFI::Platypus -e1 || cpanm FFI::Platypus   # skip if already installed
notes: `read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: decodes the test files and prints checksums
